name: XAccBalanceCheck
caption: Əlavə modullar / Mühasibat və balans / Hesab qalıqlarının yoxlanması

datasets.name: Accs
datasets.sql:
select
  acc.ID, acc.ACC_NO as AccountNo, acc.Name as AccName,
  t.ostat as Amount, t.pok_ostat as LAmount, t.obr_d as DebitTurnover,
  t.pok_obr_d as DebitLTurnover, t.obr_k as CreditTurnover, t.pok_obr_k as CreditLTurnover
from
  account acc,
  tenostat t
where
  t.acc_id = acc.ID
